web-guide-idea-101.audience: Viewers who enjoy the quiet details of village mornings.
web-guide-idea-101.offer: Open a defined morning window into your routine: chai, sweeping the courtyard or feeding animals. Explain what newcomers are seeing as they drop in.
web-guide-idea-101.steps.0: Choose the parts of the routine you are comfortable sharing.
web-guide-idea-101.steps.1: Introduce the setting and repeat brief context for new arrivals.
web-guide-idea-101.steps.2: Close at a natural pause and announce your next planned window.
web-guide-idea-101.equipment: A phone, stable support and a charged battery. Keep private rooms and other people off-camera unless they agree.
web-guide-idea-101.returnReason: Familiar places and small seasonal changes give viewers a reason to follow your calendar.
web-guide-idea-101.promotion: Share a short view of the morning setting and a realistic start time.

web-guide-idea-101.metadataDescription: Let viewers drop into your morning chai, household chores and village routine. Learn what to offer, how to start and what equipment you need.
